title: John Harbaugh on Darius Slayton's release: We do what's in the best interest of the team

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: John Harbaugh on Darius Slayton's release: We do what's in the best interest of the team
sources.description: The Giants kept wide receiver Darius Slayton on their initial 53-player roster, but released him on Monday.
